historical_references.reference: Litan was a renowned Hindu scholar and philosopher who contributed significantly to the Jain philosophy during the medieval period. He is known to have authored several important texts on Jainism, including the 'Lokavibhanga Sutras' and the 'Kalpa Sutra'. Litan's works were influential in shaping the doctrines of Jainism and have been studied by scholars for centuries.

Litan is also referred to as 'Haribhadra Suri' and is considered one of the greatest Acharyas in Jain history. He was born in Karnataka, India, during the 9th century and is believed to have studied under the great Jain scholar and philosopher, Mahavira Sthavirasena. Litan's teachings emphasized non-violence, self-discipline, and detachment, and he is revered by many Jains for his contributions to the Jain tradition.
